headline: L3Harris (LHX) Lands Seven Year Missile Propulsion Deals For PAC 3 And THAAD
summary: L3Harris Technologies (NYSE:LHX) has signed multi year propulsion agreements with the Department of War and Lockheed Martin. The contracts cover missile propulsion production for the PAC 3 MSE and THAAD defense systems. The agreements are described as transformative and are intended to nearly triple and quadruple propulsion output for these programs.
